clue.text: For reflection, left a minute in pilgrimage at mausoleum

indicators.note: a reflection shows things the wrong way round, so the whole assembly is read backwards
the minute sits inside the pilgrimage word

parts.note: the hajj is the Muslim pilgrimage to Mecca, spelt HAJ in crosswords
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone on a pilgrimage pauses for a moment of reflection at a famous tomb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For reflection' reverses everything: L, A, HA(M)J and AT give LAHAMJAT, read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous white marble building at Agra was built by Shah Jahan as a tomb for his wife.

clue.text: In regions, start to need stadia

indicators.note: the opening letter is placed inside the word for regions

parts.note: regions are areas

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Somewhere in the country, a demand arises for new sports grounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Stadia and arenas are both large venues for sport or spectacle, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Island state engaged in formal talks

indicators.note: the letters are held within the phrase formal talks, spanning its two words

explanation.surface: A small country takes part in official diplomatic negotiations.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mediterranean nation south of Sicily is a sovereign island republic.

clue.text: One presumably not having to deal with letter?

definitions.text: One presumably not having to deal with letter?

parts.words: One presumably not having to deal with letter?
parts.note: a letter here is one who lets property, a landlord; someone owning their own house has no landlord to deal with

explanation.surface: Someone who seems to escape the chore of answering correspondence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Letter' looks like post, but it means a person who lets out property.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who owns the house they live in pays no rent and so has no landlord to answer to.

clue.text: Crime world's wise old bird placed in criminal file

indicators.note: the bird is set inside the rearranged letters
criminal suggests something bent or corrupted, so the letters of file are rearranged

parts.note: the owl is traditionally the wise old bird

explanation.surface: A shrewd old detective is put on the case of a criminal dossier from the underworld.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crime world' is the definition; the possessive 's simply links it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The disreputable underclass of gangsters and petty thieves is collectively called the criminal underworld.

clue.text: River featuring during deputy's leave

indicators.note: the river appears in the middle of the deputy abbreviation

parts.note: DEP is the abbreviation for deputy
the Cam is the river through Cambridge

explanation.surface: A deputy takes time off while a river features prominently.
explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to depart suddenly or secretly, so it means to leave.

clue.text: Meaning of piled-up snow

definitions.meaning: the gist or general sense of what someone says
a bank of snow heaped up by the wind

explanation.surface: Someone asks what a snow bank signifies.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting someone's gist is catching their sense, and wind heaps snow into banks of the same name.

clue.text: Trade in a chippy?

parts.note: a chippy is British slang both for a fish-and-chip shop and for a joiner who works wood; the craft of the latter is meant

explanation.surface: Business at the local fish-and-chip shop.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a chippy is a fish-and-chip shop, which suggests takings, but it is also slang for a woodworker.
explanation.definitionFit: Woodworking is the craft or trade practised by a joiner, who is nicknamed a chippy.

clue.text: Breakfast ingredient to expand enormously

definitions.meaning: a fungus fried as part of a full English breakfast
to grow suddenly and very fast, as a verb

explanation.surface: A breakfast item swells to huge proportions.
explanation.definitionFit: The fungus is a fry-up staple, and as a verb it describes rapid growth like a fungus springing up.

clue.text: Night light is unfinished, causing chaos

indicators.note: unfinished means the final letter is lost

parts.note: a bedside lamp is a light used at night

explanation.surface: A half-broken lamp by the bed causes mayhem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is unfinished' drops the final P of BEDLAMP.
explanation.definitionFit: The name comes from a notorious London asylum, and now means uproar and confusion.

clue.text: One offering 'A stew, sir?', taking order

definitions.text: One offering 'A stew, sir?', taking order

indicators.note: the letters are put into a new order, while a server takes orders

explanation.surface: A server proposes a stew to a diner while taking the order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking order' doubles as the anagram signal for A STEW SIR.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman serving food in a restaurant offers dishes to diners and takes their orders.

clue.text: Marciano cooking food from the old country?

indicators.note: cooking suggests ingredients being mixed up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Boxer Rocky Marciano, of Italian descent, prepares a dish from his ancestral homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: Rocky Marciano was an Italian-American boxer, so his old country is Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: This pasta is a classic Italian dish, food from Italy, the homeland of Italian-Americans.

clue.text: Greek man really discontented in practice? The opposite

parts.note: Theo is a man's name from Greek, short for Theodore

indicators.note: with its contents gone, only the outer letters of really remain

explanation.surface: A Greek fellow is truly unhappy in his work.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the phrase 'in practice', whose opposite is 'in theory'.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstract principles are traditionally contrasted with practice, the doing of something.

clue.text: Voices rant on possibly in this

definitions.text: Voices rant on possibly in this

indicators.note: possibly suggests one of several arrangements of the letters

explanation.surface: People's voices may go on and on during a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A talk between people is where voices may run on at length, so the whole clue describes it.

clue.text: Polite composer broadcast — it's for royalty's benefit?

parts.note: civil means courteous

indicators.note: broadcast means put on the air, so the name is heard rather than seen

parts.note: Franz Liszt was a Hungarian composer

explanation.surface: A courteous composer goes on air with a programme that benefits royals.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the annual sum Parliament formerly granted the British monarch to cover official expenses.

clue.text: Only fool wearing surprised expression — or glumness

parts.note: sole means only

indicators.note: the expression wears the fool, so it goes around it

parts.note: my! is an exclamation of surprise
a nit is a fool in British slang

explanation.surface: A lone idiot pulls a shocked face, or a gloomy one.
explanation.definitionFit: Gravity or seriousness of manner is close to a glum, unsmiling mood.

clue.text: Prize honey

definitions.meaning: to prize is to value highly, as a verb
a term of endearment, a darling or precious person

explanation.definitionFit: To value something dearly is to cherish it, and a beloved person is called a precious jewel or gem.

clue.text: In the style of a gnome?

definitions.text: In the style of a gnome?

parts.words: In the style of a gnome?
parts.note: a gnome is also a pithy saying or maxim, so speaking like one means speaking in sayings

explanation.surface: Something done the way a garden gnome would do it.
explanation.walkthrough: A gnome is a little garden figure, but also a short, wise saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A gnome in this sense is an aphorism, so something said in the style of one is said as a well-known saying.

clue.text: Momentum one found with working of temp (American)

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

indicators.note: the letters of temp are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: A temporary worker in America gains drive from their job.
explanation.definitionFit: Driving force or forward thrust is the same idea as momentum.

clue.text: Explore curved building in Kent?

parts.note: Kent is a county in the South East of England, SE
an arch is a curved structure

explanation.surface: Someone investigates a vaulted structure in an English county.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent is a county in South East England, so it stands for SE.
explanation.definitionFit: To explore an area thoroughly is to comb or hunt through it.

clue.text: Actor not fully developed

definitions.meaning: Simon ... is an English stage and screen actor

explanation.surface: A performer who has not yet matured.
explanation.definitionFit: Simon Callow is a well-known English actor, and the adjective means young and inexperienced.

clue.text: Make material depiction of European in part of sea

indicators.note: the abbreviation goes inside the sea word

parts.note: a wave is a moving ridge on the sea

explanation.surface: An artist creates a picture of a European swimming in the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Fabric is made on a loom by interlacing threads, so this is how cloth is produced.

clue.text: Current measure with hard Latin put in favoured treatise

indicators.note: these letters are placed inside the favoured word

parts.note: a pet is a favoured one, as in teacher's pet
the amp is the unit of electric current
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: An electrical study written with tough Latin terms becomes a cherished paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A short printed booklet arguing a case is a small treatise or tract.

clue.text: Language in church in dispute

indicators.note: the letters run inside the phrase church in dispute, across its words

explanation.surface: A quarrel inside a church over which tongue to use.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the official languages of India, widely spoken across the north.

clue.text: Transported con's last in jail but being reformed

indicators.note: the final letter of con goes inside the rearranged letters
reformed suggests remade into a new shape, so the letters of jail but are rearranged
the last letter of a word is its final one

explanation.surface: A prisoner is moved out of jail, though he is being rehabilitated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transported' suggests convicts shipped away, but here means ecstatic.
explanation.definitionFit: Transported can mean carried away with joy, so it fits overjoyed and triumphant.

clue.text: Pass by Italian ladies missing sun

indicators.note: the sun letter is left out

parts.note: signore is Italian for ladies, plural of signora

explanation.surface: Some women from Italy walk past without catching the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass someone by is to disregard or take no notice of them.

clue.text: Come to rest in seat with high back

definitions.meaning: to land or ... down after moving
a wooden bench with a high back and arms

explanation.surface: Someone sits down in a tall-backed chair.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to come to rest, and as a noun it is an old high-backed wooden bench.

clue.text: Broadcaster with kind of entertainment opening that's over one's head

parts.note: Sky is a British satellite broadcaster
light entertainment is a TV genre of comedy and variety

explanation.surface: A TV channel offers a show that goes over the viewer's head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over one's head' suggests too clever to follow, but means literally overhead.
explanation.definitionFit: A window set into a roof is an opening for daylight above you.
